hints.title: Concatenate Strings
hints.text: Join all string elements in each array into a single combined string.

hints.title: Compare Concatenations
hints.text: Compare the two combined strings for direct equality.

hints.title: Two-Pointer Alternative
hints.text: Alternatively, iterate through characters with two pointers across word boundaries without extra string allocation.

hints.title: Full Implementation

variables: n is total characters across words
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Individual character matching without tracking word indices introduces indexing bugs.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Joining strings runs in O(n) time and O(n) space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should note both the straightforward join approach and the O(1) space two-pointer approach.
